status: Implemented; disabled until Apple credentials and physical-device validation are complete

requirements: Enable Push Notifications for the bundle ID in the Apple Developer account
Generate an APNs signing key restricted to the intended topic/environment where supported
Refresh the app provisioning profile and sign the native build
Debug uses aps-environment=development and APNs sandbox; Release/TestFlight uses production

vercelProductionSecrets.NISFAYN_SUPABASE_URL: Dedicated Nisfayn project only; never the BlindMatch event project
vercelProductionSecrets.NISFAYN_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: Server-only service-role JWT or Supabase secret key
vercelProductionSecrets.APNS_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64: Base64 of the complete .p8 PEM file; never include in client builds

clientBuild.VITE_MARRIAGE_PUSH_ENABLED: true only after server setup and device validation

worker.schedule: Configure an authenticated schedule at the required delivery cadence after checking the Vercel team's scheduling allowance. No schedule is enabled by this implementation.
worker.preview: Worker refuses VERCEL_ENV=preview. Do not copy production APNs or service credentials into preview.
worker.batch: Up to 20 queued jobs, five concurrent sends, APNs HTTP/2 with an ES256 provider token, 120-second leases, bounded retries, 15-minute job expiry; completed queue entries are removed after seven days during worker calls.
worker.privacy: Only generic request/mutual/message copy and an opaque request ID go to APNs. No names, message content, photo URLs, or assessment answers. Eligibility is checked at claim and immediately before sending. Already delivered notifications cannot be remotely recalled.

acceptanceTestsBeforeEnabling: Install signed sandbox build on a physical iPhone
Enable from Settings and verify permission refusal/recovery
Confirm generic notification on a second device while app is backgrounded
Tap through to the same authorized request/thread
Verify both-direction blocking, pause, expired membership, logout, and account switching suppress subsequent sends
Test APNs invalid token cleanup and production/TestFlight environment separation
